title: Shared focus v1
description: The shared focus ("Follow me"): the place the owner is looking at, which any surface publishes and any other follows, with no leader (packages/core/src/session/focus.ts is the source; docs/standard/contract-1.md says the rules). GET /api/session/focus answers `view`; POST /api/session/focus takes `post` and answers `answer`; the companion stream's `event: shared` carries `view` too. Ids only, never a selection. This root is never itself on the wire: each property names one payload. Additive only: a field added later is optional, and a breaking change is a new suffix (shared-focus-2).

place.description: A place, as a publish carries it and the view's shared place holds it.

shared.description: view.shared when someone has published (it is null before): the shared place with who put it there.

post.description: The body of POST /api/session/focus: one move on the caller's own reader record.

productSlug.description: A registered product's slug (the registry's own rule), or `kettle` for the sample.

readerId.description: A reader's own id: letters, digits, . _ : - (a LAN device speaks as `vr:<device>`).

placeKind.description: The same kinds the place baton and the companion's focus.show send.

focusOp.description: hello: I am here (every 15 s while open); publish: I am looking here; follow / unfollow; forget: I am closing.

focusPlace.description: Where: a product, and optionally one target in it. Absent target: the product as a whole (the site).

hash.description: The publishing page's own hash ('#at=bkg-06&lens=perf'); a follower on the same product may use it. Never ''.

say.description: One plain line said with the place. A Morning decision card sends its title, a newline, then its brief's short line (a lower third shows both).

label.description: What other surfaces call the publisher: 'Web', 'Phone', 'VR table', 'Glim'.

at.description: ISO time of the publish that made this the shared place (an echo keeps it).

follows.description: '*' (whoever moves) or one reader id; absent: not following.

live.description: Seen in the last 45 s (LIVE_MS); clients say hello every 15 s while open.

sharedView.description: What a client sees: the shared place (null before anyone published) and every reader.

rev.description: Grows by one each time the shared place moves; an echo or a presence change keeps it.

shared.description: A sharedPlace, or null before anyone published.

focusPost.description: One move. hello, publish and follow name the caller (surface, label); publish carries a place, follow carries `of`.

of.description: follow: '*' or a reader id (never the caller's own).

moved.description: The shared place moved (201, a new rev); false for an echo or a presence-only move (200).
